from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Temple Documentation Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a documentation robot taking pictures in a temple while respecting social norms.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.temple_interior = Object("temple_interior", self.Location)
        self.archive_storage = Object("archive_storage", self.Location)
        self.priest_area = Object("priest_area", self.Location)
        self.camera = Object("camera", self.ObjectType)
        self.priest = Object("priest", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.picture_taken = Fluent("picture_taken", BoolType(), location=self.Location)
        self.priest_visible = Fluent("priest_visible", BoolType())

        self.setting_is_temple = Fluent("setting_is_temple", BoolType())
        self.priest_present = Fluent("priest_present", BoolType())
        self.camera_has_object_detection = Fluent("camera_has_object_detection", BoolType())
        self.camera_can_identify_individuals = Fluent("camera_can_identify_individuals", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.picture_taken, self.priest_visible]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_temple, self.priest_present, self.camera_has_object_detection, self.camera_can_identify_individuals]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.temple_interior, self.archive_storage, self.priest_area, self.camera, self.priest]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_temple = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_temple")
        navigate_to_temple.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.temple_interior)))
        navigate_to_temple.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.archive_storage), False)
        navigate_to_temple.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.priest_area), False)
        navigate_to_temple.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.temple_interior), True)
        
        navigate_to_archive = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_archive")
        navigate_to_archive.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.archive_storage)))
        navigate_to_archive.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.temple_interior), False)
        navigate_to_archive.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.priest_area), False)
        navigate_to_archive.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.archive_storage), True)

        navigate_to_priest_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_priest_area")
        navigate_to_priest_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.priest_area)))
        navigate_to_priest_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.temple_interior), False)
        navigate_to_priest_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.archive_storage), False)
        navigate_to_priest_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.priest_area), True)

        pickup_camera = InstantaneousAction("pickup_camera")
        pickup_camera.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.archive_storage))
        pickup_camera.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.camera, self.archive_storage))
        pickup_camera.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.camera)))
        pickup_camera.add_effect(self.object_at(self.camera, self.archive_storage), False)
        pickup_camera.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.camera), True)

        take_picture_temple = InstantaneousAction("take_picture_temple")
        take_picture_temple.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.temple_interior))
        take_picture_temple.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.camera))
        take_picture_temple.add_precondition(Not(self.picture_taken(self.temple_interior)))
        take_picture_temple.add_effect(self.picture_taken(self.temple_interior), True)

        move_priest = InstantaneousAction("move_priest")
        move_priest.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.priest_area))
        move_priest.add_precondition(self.priest_present)
        move_priest.add_effect(self.priest_present, False)
        move_priest.add_effect(self.priest_visible, False)

        set_priest_visible = InstantaneousAction("set_priest_visible")
        set_priest_visible.add_precondition(self.priest_present)
        set_priest_visible.add_precondition(Not(self.priest_visible))
        set_priest_visible.add_effect(self.priest_visible, True)

        return navigate_to_temple, navigate_to_archive, navigate_to_priest_area, pickup_camera, take_picture_temple, move_priest, set_priest_visible

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "take_picture_temple": And([
                self.priest_visible,
                Not(self.camera_can_identify_individuals)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.archive_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.camera, self.archive_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.priest, self.priest_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.priest_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.priest_visible, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.camera_has_object_detection, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.camera_can_identify_individuals, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.picture_taken(self.temple_interior))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
